You are not going to keep it?

Who is your ravishing friend?
Hicham, we are not at the office.
I am Hicham Janowski.
Colette Brancillon. Nice to meet you.
Hicham is the shareholder of ASK.
I must get going now.
Have a good evening, both of you.
